lesson.sw: Mwitikio wa sehemu ni mkakati halisi, si kutokuwa na uamuzi. Unabadilisha margin kidogo kwa ulinzi kidogo, kwa makusudi.

outcome.en: You hold close to your current price. Margin per loaf stays strong, but some distributors will drift to the cheaper competitor.
outcome.sw: Unashikilia karibu na bei yako ya sasa. Margin kwa kila mkate inabaki nzuri, lakini baadhi ya wasambazaji watahamia kwa mshindani mwenye bei nafuu.

lesson.en: Holding your price protects margin on every loaf you still sell, at the cost of some you no longer do.
lesson.sw: Kushikilia bei yako kunalinda margin kwa kila mkate unaouza bado, kwa gharama ya baadhi usiouza tena.

outcome.en: You raise the price above where it was, betting on the loaves distributors who value reliability over the lowest price. Volume is the most exposed here.
outcome.sw: Unapandisha bei juu ya ilivyokuwa, ukibashiri kwa wasambazaji wa mikate wanaothamini uhakika zaidi ya bei ya chini kabisa. Wingi ndio ulio hatarini zaidi hapa.

lesson.en: Differentiating on something other than price is a real option, but it only works if distributors actually value what you are offering instead.
lesson.sw: Kutofautisha kwa kitu kingine zaidi ya bei ni chaguo halisi, lakini kinafanya kazi tu kama wasambazaji wanathamini hasa kile unachotoa badala yake.

conceptLabel.en: A batch fails at a distributor
conceptLabel.sw: Kundi la bidhaa linashindwa kwa msambazaji

situation.en: A distributor calls: a batch of loaves arrived under-baked and has to be pulled from their shelves. Customers who bought it already are asking for a refund.
situation.sw: Msambazaji anapiga simu: kundi la mikate limefika bila kuiva vizuri na lazima liondolewe kwenye rafu zao. Wateja waliokwisha kununua wanaomba fedha zao zirudishwe.

label.en: Trace which oven and which shift produced the failed batch
label.sw: Fuatilia oveni gani na zamu gani ilizalisha kundi lililoshindwa

reveals.en: A single oven ran under temperature for one shift. It is a specific, fixable fault, not a sign of a factory-wide problem.
reveals.sw: Oveni moja ilifanya kazi chini ya joto kwa zamu moja. Ni hitilafu maalum, inayoweza kurekebishwa, si dalili ya tatizo la kiwanda kizima.

prompt.en: How do you respond to the distributor?
prompt.sw: Unamjibuje msambazaji?

predictQuestion.en: What happens to your weekly profit?

label.en: Recall the batch immediately and cover the full replacement
label.sw: Rejesha kundi mara moja na ulipe uingizwaji kamili

detail.en: The cost is yours alone. The response is fast and visible.
detail.sw: Gharama ni yako pekee. Mwitikio ni wa haraka na unaoonekana.

outcome.en: This week's loaves output drops hard while the line is checked, the batch replaced, and the recall handled. Distributors see a factory that owns its mistakes quickly.
outcome.sw: Uzalishaji wa mikate wa wiki hii unashuka sana wakati mstari unakaguliwa, kundi linabadilishwa, na urejeshaji unashughulikiwa. Wasambazaji wanaona kiwanda kinachomiliki makosa yake haraka.

lesson.en: Owning a setback fully costs something immediately. It is often cheaper than the reputation damage of being seen to dodge it.
lesson.sw: Kumiliki tatizo kikamilifu kunagharimu kitu mara moja. Mara nyingi ni gharama nafuu zaidi kuliko uharibifu wa sifa wa kuonekana ukilikwepa.

cause.en: the fast, visible recall that reassured distributors you catch your own mistakes
cause.sw: kurejesha kwa haraka, kunakoonekana, kulikohakikishia wasambazaji unagundua makosa yako mwenyewe

label.en: Say the batch was fine and blame the distributor's handling
label.sw: Sema kundi lilikuwa sawa na lawama uhifadhi wa msambazaji

detail.en: No cost today. The distributor is left to deal with their own customers.
detail.sw: Hakuna gharama leo. Msambazaji anaachwa kushughulikia wateja wake mwenyewe.

outcome.en: Nothing changes on this week's ledger. The distributor is left holding customer complaints about a batch you will not acknowledge.
outcome.sw: Hakuna kinachobadilika kwenye daftari la wiki hii. Msambazaji anaachwa akishughulikia malalamiko ya wateja kuhusu kundi ambalo hutalikubali.

lesson.en: Denying a real setback avoids its cost this week. The cost does not disappear; it moves to the relationship, and it usually returns larger.
lesson.sw: Kukataa tatizo halisi kunaepuka gharama yake wiki hii. Gharama haitoweki; inahamia kwenye uhusiano, na kwa kawaida inarudi kubwa zaidi.

cause.en: the recall you denied, until two distributors dropped you
cause.sw: kurejesha ulikokataa, hadi wasambazaji wawili walipokuacha

label.en: Recall the batch but ask the distributor to share the cost
label.sw: Rejesha kundi lakini omba msambazaji ashiriki gharama

detail.en: A smaller loss for you, and a harder conversation with the distributor.
detail.sw: Hasara ndogo kwako, na mazungumzo magumu zaidi na msambazaji.

outcome.en: The distributor agrees to share part of the cost, after some negotiation, but output still drops while the batch is fixed. The relationship survives, though it is cooler than before.
outcome.sw: Msambazaji anakubali kushiriki sehemu ya gharama, baada ya mazungumzo, lakini uzalishaji bado unashuka wakati kundi linarekebishwa. Uhusiano unaendelea kuwepo, ingawa umepoa kuliko awali.

lesson.en: Sharing the cost of a setback is a real middle ground. It protects your own cash more than owning it fully, at some cost to trust.
lesson.sw: Kushiriki gharama ya tatizo ni njia halisi ya kati. Inalinda pesa yako mwenyewe zaidi kuliko kumiliki kikamilifu, kwa gharama fulani ya imani.
